relationship: For a fixed reference angle, resizing a right triangle changes side lengths but preserves the appropriate sine, cosine or tangent ratio.

learnerLoop.action: Choose the reference angle, resize the triangle and select or calculate the needed ratio.
learnerLoop.modelChange: The triangle dimensions and side-role labels update while the angle remains fixed.
learnerLoop.evidence: The glidepath construction, ratio display and checked working show invariant side proportions.
learnerLoop.nextDecision: Choose the ratio that connects the known side to the required side.

invariants: Corresponding side ratios for a fixed angle remain unchanged under resizing.
Side roles are defined relative to the selected reference angle.
safeAdaptations: Vary fixed angles, target sides and solvable right triangles.
Adjust working support while retaining interactive resizing and side-role evidence.
nonGoals: Choosing a trigonometric ratio from absolute side position rather than reference-angle roles.

task.description: Current problem statement and supplied quantities.
task.visibility: Shown at the start of each problem or stage.

model.description: Operated construction and its live measurements; see quantities for what is given and revealed.
model.visibility: Present for the current problem; child controls and readouts follow the states described below.

working.description: Ordered calculations, learner entries and consequential evidence for the current task.
working.visibility: Present for the current problem; child controls and readouts follow the states described below.

completion.description: Achievement, next task or learning transition.
completion.visibility: Shown only when the local completion conditions below are satisfied; representation controls are separately identified.

feedback.description: Progress/correctness surfaces for reference, scale/roles, ratio and result.
feedback.visibility: Present for the current problem; child controls and readouts follow the states described below.

reference-and-given-side.description: A specified acute reference angle and one supplied side length.
reference-and-given-side.domain: Acute degrees and length in m; reference may be runway, upper acute or depression angle.
reference-and-given-side.source: Generated givens. Learner selects the named arc.
reference-and-given-side.output: Selection defines opposite/adjacent roles for the same physical sides.

scale.description: The triangle scale is adjusted until the supplied side matches; fixed-angle ratios remain invariant.
scale.domain: Positive lengths in m on the fixed glidepath.
scale.source: Learner drags the aircraft or uses its keys.
scale.output: Live side lengths, target guide and sin/cos/tan ratio strip update.

roles-ratio-result.description: Three side-role classifications, one trig-function choice, and ONE missing side length. Choice buttons are alternatives; O/A/H are labels relative to the reference.
roles-ratio-result.domain: O/A/H; sin/cos/tan; length to one decimal place.
roles-ratio-result.source: Required at Some/All as described by modes.
roles-ratio-result.output: Role correctness and scale gate ratio choices; a correct ratio gates the answer field.

modes.none: Learner chooses the reference arc and resizes to the given side; side roles, ratio and calculation are shown.
modes.some: Additionally choose the ratio and enter the missing side.
modes.all: Also identify O/A/H for each physical side before the ratio and result unlock.

dependencies: The given side must match; in All, all physical-side roles must also be correct.
Correct ratio selection unlocks result entry; None supplies the calculation but still requires the physical construction.
implementation.completion: problemComplete() combines reference, matched scale, required role/ratio choices and the missing-side answer; shared completion then permits another generated problem.
